title: revOS Evidence Record
description: Canonical evidence record for every claim a sprint-1 subsystem agent makes about a macOS Foundation/CoreFoundation/libdispatch symbol, type, function, constant, or behavior. Conform by running scripts/lib/validate_evidence.py over subsystems/**/evidence/*.json.

subsystem.description: Which subsystem agent owns this evidence record.

subject.description: The symbol, API, struct, constant, or behavior being claimed about. Use the exact observed spelling (e.g. 'CFRunLoopRunInMode', 'CFTypeID', 'dispatch_async_f').

path.description: Path to the artifact the observation was made against. May be repo-relative or absolute. For downloaded artifacts use the cache path under /Users/vaithianathan/revOS-work/cache/.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the artifact file contents at observation time. Use `shasum -a 256 <path>` (macOS) or `sha256sum`.

tool_invocation.description: The exact CLI invocation used. Include all flags. Use the scripts/bin/* wrappers when possible; record the verbatim shell command for reproducibility. Example: 'scripts/bin/nm-symbols /usr/lib/system/libxpc.dylib'

summary.description: Human-readable description of what the tool observed. One or two sentences.

raw_output_excerpt.description: A short (<= 1 KB) excerpt of the actual tool output that supports the claim. Do NOT include proprietary blobs.

claim.description: One sentence statement of what we believe, in present tense. Must be falsifiable.

claim_status.description: observed = directly emitted by source_artifact. deduced = reasoned from observed evidence and a comparison to an open-source mirror. unknown = not yet established; mark explicitly to prevent fabrication.

cross_reference.description: References to the open-source mirrors we will diff against. Use upstream values from the enum; add URL and a short human-readable label.

confidence.description: 0..1 numeric confidence. observed symbols from otool/nm start at 0.9; deduced behaviors start at 0.5; unknown starts at 0.0.

reproducer.description: Shell command(s), one per line, that re-derive this evidence from source_artifact. Prefer scripts/bin/* wrappers so re-runs are deterministic.
